## What was written

`src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DateUtilsAgentTest.java` — one class, `DateUtilsAgentTest`, in package `org.apache.commons.lang3.time`.

**Style match:** the sibling `time`-package tests (`DateUtilsRoundingTest`, `DateUtilsFragmentTest`, `DateFormatUtilsTest`, …) all use JUnit 3 (`extends junit.framework.TestCase`, `testXxx()` methods, `setUp()`, `fail()` in a `try/catch` for error cases). This class follows the same convention, and reuses their `SimpleDateFormat("MMM dd, yyyy H:mm:ss.SSS", Locale.ENGLISH)` parsing approach so date comparisons stay timezone-consistent.

**Coverage of the public API (58 tests):**
- `isSameDay` / `isSameInstant` / `isSameLocalTime` (Date + Calendar overloads): equal / not-equal cases, cross-timezone same-instant-vs-same-local-time distinction, the 1am/1pm `HOUR_OF_DAY` case, different concrete `Calendar` subclass, `IllegalArgumentException` on null.
- `parseDate` / `parseDateStrictly`: successful parse, fall-through to a later pattern, lenient roll-over vs. strict `ParseException`, `ParseException` on no match / no patterns, `IllegalArgumentException` on null string / null patterns.
- `addYears…addMilliseconds`: value checks incl. negative amounts, year-boundary and midnight roll-over, argument-not-mutated, `IllegalArgumentException` on null.
- `setYears…setMilliseconds`: value checks, argument-not-mutated, out-of-range values rejected (non-lenient: month 12, day 32/0, hour 24, minute/second 60, ms 1000), null rejected.
- `toCalendar`: returned value + `NullPointerException` on null.
- `round` / `truncate` / `ceiling` (Date, Calendar, Object): field-by-field expected results (SECOND→YEAR, plus `AM_PM` and `SEMI_MONTH`), the <500ms/≥500ms rounding boundary, year round-up (October), clone-not-mutate for the Calendar form, `IllegalArgumentException` (null / unsupported field), `ClassCastException` (wrong Object type).
- `iterator` (Date, Calendar, Object): `RANGE_WEEK_SUNDAY` / `RANGE_WEEK_MONDAY` start/end day and count of 7, `NoSuchElementException` when exhausted, `UnsupportedOperationException` from `remove()`, `IllegalArgumentException` (null / invalid range style), `ClassCastException` (wrong type).
- `getFragmentInMilliseconds/Seconds/Minutes/Hours/Days` (Date + Calendar): computed expected values, sub-unit fragments returning 0, `IllegalArgumentException` on null and on unsupported fragment (`Calendar.ERA`).
- `truncatedEquals` / `truncatedCompareTo` (Date + Calendar): equal/not-equal at SECOND vs MINUTE vs HOUR, sign of comparison both directions, `IllegalArgumentException` on null.
